groups.name: Electron portable runtime
groups.updateMethod: Replace the complete verified Windows runtime including executable, DLLs, locales and snapshots from one upstream archive; run populated Electron acceptance and final regression before any release. Never replace only a DLL or the version marker.
groups.versionEvidence: Declared source distribution version file; the executable is intentionally not tracked in this source repository. No running or published artifact identity is certified by this SBOM.

groups.name: CesiumJS
groups.updateMethod: Replace the complete pinned Cesium distribution with Workers, Assets, ThirdParty, Widgets and license inventory; verify offline map and asset loading.
groups.versionEvidence: Bundle license header and exported VERSION; tree hashes recorded. Nested third-party/data notices are retained in LICENSE.md.

groups.name: ExcelJS
groups.updateMethod: Vendor the pinned official browser distribution and license; verify workbook date, style, formula and image exports.
groups.versionEvidence: Exact official package dist/exceljs.min.js bytes, archive integrity verified.

groups.name: SheetJS CE isolated browser reader
groups.updateMethod: Update the pinned official local tarball and npm lock together; copy its browser reader and license, retain isolation/ZIP guards and pass import financial/date/formula/style fixtures.
groups.versionEvidence: Browser reader copied from the same installed, integrity-pinned official tarball as the Node reader.

groups.name: xlsx-js-style legacy browser writer
groups.updateMethod: Keep write-only; never route untrusted imports to this fork. Replacement requires equivalent style/formula/date/image export fixtures and a pinned licensed source.
groups.versionEvidence: Exact official package dist/xlsx.bundle.js bytes. SheetJS read-path advisories are not a waiver for future read callers; tests enforce worker reader usage.

groups.name: Legacy ExcelJS browser compatibility shims
groups.updateMethod: Review or remove with the supported Electron/browser baseline; retain the SheetJS copyright notice. Do not identify these modified polyfills as a verified upstream release.
groups.versionEvidence: Existing SheetJS-attributed compatibility code; exact upstream artifact equivalence was not established. It contains compatibility shims, not workbook parsing.

groups.name: PDF.js legacy browser and Node distribution
groups.updateMethod: Update library and worker as one compatible pair, retain eval-disabled configuration, process/worker limits and PDF text/raster fixtures; newer ESM major versions require explicit integration changes.
groups.versionEvidence: Exact official legacy/build/pdf.min.js and legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.js bytes. GHSA-wgrm-67xf-hhpq workaround isEvalSupported:false applies at every application entry.

groups.name: jsPDF browser raster PDF writer
groups.updateMethod: Upgrade the pinned UMD bundle with its license and verify raster PDF output/attachments. Review upstream advisories against actual API use; do not equate npm audit zero with browser vendor safety.
groups.versionEvidence: Exact official UMD bytes. Current application uses canvas JPEG addImage and output('blob'), not HTML/new-window output, AcroForm, addJS, GIF/BMP or Node file-loading APIs.

groups.name: JSZip
groups.updateMethod: Vendor pinned minified distribution and license; verify bounded archive import plus template/formula/style/image preservation. MIT license option used.

groups.name: World atlas / Natural Earth map data
groups.updateMethod: Replace map data only with a pinned documented source; preserve Natural Earth public-domain and world-atlas ISC notices; verify both map resolutions.
groups.versionEvidence: Existing bundled source notice; 110m has an alternate imported provenance documented in world-atlas-LICENSE.txt. No byte-equivalence claim for that import.

groups.name: Thinking-orbs adapted canvas states
groups.updateMethod: Maintain the local dependency-free adaptation, attribution and reduced-motion behavior together; verify working/breathing states.
groups.versionEvidence: Local adaptations with copyright/license notice; not an unchanged upstream package.

groups.name: Barlow and Barlow Condensed WOFF2 subsets
groups.updateMethod: Replace font subsets as one documented pinned family; keep both OFL notices, Latin/Latin-ext coverage and density/readability acceptance.
groups.versionEvidence: Existing named WOFF2 subsets; no upstream version stamp was recorded. Per-file hashes identify the exact distribution; source equivalence is not claimed.

groups.name: IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono WOFF2
groups.updateMethod: Replace packaged Plex fonts together with their OFL notices; verify Turkish coverage, offline loading and all four UI scales.
groups.versionEvidence: Packaged WOFF2 files and adjacent IBM Plex OFL notices; no upstream version stamp was recorded. Exact per-file SHA-256 identifies this source distribution; upstream byte equivalence is not claimed.
